title: Support Case Insights environment configuration
description: Configuration for config/<env>.json. The CDK app validates every file against this schema, applies the defaults shown here, then applies the cross-field rules listed in $comment before any stack is synthesised.
$comment: Cross-field rules enforced by lib/config/load.ts in addition to this schema: operations.queues.visibilityTimeoutSeconds (when set) >= 6 x operations.functions.consumerTimeoutSeconds; operations.cleanup.graceHours x 60 > operations.workflow.executionTimeoutMinutes; rawRetentionDays x 24 > operations.cleanup.graceHours; every cron schedule uses '?' in exactly one of day-of-month or day-of-week, and each field is valid for EventBridge Scheduler and AWS Glue (minutes 0-59, hours 0-23, day-of-month 1-31 or L, LW, nW, month 1-12 or JAN-DEC, day-of-week 1-7 or SUN-SAT or L, nL, n#k with k 1-5, year 1970-2199; lists, ranges and /increments of these values); schedules.crawler leaves at least 5 minutes between consecutive runs, as AWS Glue requires; apiGatewayLogging.existingRoleArn is in managementAccountId. When synthesising one environment, the app also reads the other config/<env>.json (if present) and rejects different apiGatewayLogging settings for environments in the same account and Region.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this schema.

uniqueId.description: Deployment namespace appended to every resource name (for example Support-Case-Analysis-Role-<uniqueId>). Lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens; starts with a letter.

orgId.description: AWS Organizations ID used in aws:PrincipalOrgID trust and resource-policy conditions.

managementAccountId.description: Organization management account ID. The stacks deploy here and this account is excluded from case collection.

region.description: AWS Region for every stack and the single Region used for the member-role StackSet.

environment.description: Deployment environment. Must match the -c env=<name> context and the config file name. Prod retains data on stack deletion and requires alarmEmail.

enableAnalytics.description: Deploy the optional Analytics stack (Glue database, crawler and Athena workgroup).

enableMcp.description: Deploy the optional MCP server stack. Requires enableAnalytics and at least one mcpAllowedPrincipals entry.

memberRoleTargets.description: Organization root (r-...) or organizational unit (ou-...) IDs that receive the member role through the service-managed StackSet.

bedrockModelId.description: Global Amazon Bedrock inference profile used for summaries and classifications. Only the two listed profiles are supported.

bedrockMaxTokens.description: max_tokens sent with each Bedrock request.

bedrockMaxConcurrency.description: Upper bound on concurrent Bedrock invocations across the analysis stages.

lookbackMonths.description: Trailing calendar months of case creation time to collect. The AWS Support API keeps case data for 12 months.

rawRetentionDays.description: Days before raw case metadata and conversations expire from the raw bucket.

logRetentionDays.description: CloudWatch Logs retention for every log group. Must be a value CloudWatch Logs accepts.

alarmEmail.description: Optional SNS email subscription for alarms. Required when environment is prod.

mcpAllowedPrincipals.description: IAM role or user ARNs allowed to invoke the MCP API with SigV4, in addition to the organization condition.

apiGatewayLogging.description: Owner of the account- and Region-wide API Gateway CloudWatch Logs role setting that REST API access logging requires (used only when enableMcp is true). Every environment deployed to the same account and Region must use identical settings.

mode.description: managed: the shared stack CaseInsightsApiLoggingStack-<sharedId> creates the API Gateway logging role and the single account/Region setting, retained when environments are destroyed. existing: the setting is already configured (for example by another application or a platform team) with existingRoleArn; nothing is created or changed.

sharedId.description: Namespace of the shared logging stack, independent of uniqueId so dev and prod reuse one owner. Lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens; starts with a letter.

existingRoleArn.description: Required when mode is existing, not allowed otherwise: the IAM role in managementAccountId already set as the API Gateway CloudWatch role ARN in this Region.

allOf.description: existingRoleArn is required when mode is existing and not allowed when mode is managed.

schedules.description: UTC cron expressions in EventBridge Scheduler / AWS Glue syntax: cron(minutes hours day-of-month month day-of-week year).

accountLookup.description: Daily account discovery that starts each run.

cleanup.description: Daily cleanup that makes abandoned incomplete cases eligible for the next run.

crawler.description: Daily Glue crawler run that refreshes Athena partitions (Analytics only). Runs must be at least 5 minutes apart.

operations.description: Bounded operational controls. Every value has a safe default.

maxReceiveCount.description: Receives before a message moves to its dead-letter queue.

visibilityTimeoutSeconds.description: Optional explicit visibility timeout for consumer queues. Defaults to 6 x consumerTimeoutSeconds and must never be lower than that.

dlqRetentionDays.description: Days messages stay in dead-letter queues awaiting redrive. SQS keeps a message's original enqueue time when it moves to a DLQ, so this must exceed the 4-day source-queue retention.

consumerTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout for SQS-consuming and scheduled Lambda functions.

analysisTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout for the Bedrock analysis and metadata-update workflow tasks.

executionTimeoutMinutes.description: Maximum duration of one case-analysis Standard workflow execution.

starterMaxConcurrency.description: Maximum concurrent workflow-starter invocations (SQS event source maximum concurrency, minimum 2).

taskMaxAttempts.description: Retry attempts for each workflow task before routing to failure handling.

graceHours.description: Minimum age of unfinished raw work before cleanup may treat it as abandoned.

processedInfrequentAccessDays.description: Days before processed records transition to S3 Standard-IA.

noncurrentVersionRetentionDays.description: Days noncurrent object versions are kept in versioned buckets.

accessLogRetentionDays.description: Days S3 server access logs are kept.

bytesScannedCutoffPerQuery.description: Athena workgroup per-query data-scanned limit in bytes (minimum 10 MB).

resultsRetentionDays.description: Days Athena query results (which can contain case content) are kept in the Analytics results bucket.

reservedConcurrency.description: Reserved concurrency for the MCP Lambda function. Fixed at 20; any other value is rejected.

throttleRateLimit.description: API Gateway stage steady-state requests per second.

wafRateLimitPer5Minutes.description: AWS WAF rate-based rule limit per client IP over five minutes.

allOf.description: alarmEmail is required when environment is prod.
enableMcp requires enableAnalytics to be true and at least one mcpAllowedPrincipals entry.
